fields.description: Master switch. When off, the "Generate Audio" button on a lesson refuses to run and no audio is generated.
fields.label: Lesson Audio Enabled

fields.description: Only lessons in these courses can have audio generated. Generation is refused for any other course, even if triggered manually.
fields.label: Enabled Courses

fields.description: Which provider is tried first. OpenRouter is far cheaper per character than Hugging Face's working route (fal-ai) for this model - see the rate fields below.
fields.label: Primary Provider

fields.description: If the primary provider fails, automatically retry with the other provider. Leave off to avoid any surprise spend on the non-primary provider - a failure will just fail, and you decide what to do next.
fields.label: Enable Fallback to Other Provider

fields.description: Lesson text is split into chunks of roughly this many characters before synthesis.
fields.label: Max Characters per Chunk

fields.description: Get one at huggingface.co/settings/tokens. Stored encrypted; never shown in plain text again.
fields.label: Hugging Face API Token

fields.description: The Hugging Face Inference Providers routing target. "deepinfra" does not implement text-to-speech in the installed SDK - confirmed by reading its provider registry - so this must stay "fal-ai" unless that changes upstream.
fields.label: HF Inference Provider

fields.description: Used only to show a cost estimate before generating - update if fal.ai's rate changes.
fields.label: HF Rate (USD / 1M chars)

fields.description: Leave blank to reuse the openrouter_api_key already set via bench set-config for the chat assistant. Set here to use a different key for lesson audio specifically.
fields.label: OpenRouter API Key (optional override)

fields.description: One of Kokoro's 54 preset voices (af_*/am_* American, bf_*/bm_* British, etc). af_heart is the model's own documented default.
fields.label: OpenRouter Voice

fields.description: Used only to show a cost estimate before generating - update if OpenRouter's rate changes.
fields.label: OpenRouter Rate (USD / 1M chars)
